instruction: Take a screenshot of the current video frame and save it to the Desktop

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC snapshot directory to Desktop and taking a snapshot. Steps: 1) Open VLC preferences (Tools->Preferences), 2) Change snapshot directory to /home/user/Desktop, 3) Take snapshot (Video->Take Snapshot or Shift+S). Evaluator checks if snapshot file exists on Desktop using wildcard pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: VLC snapshot file exists on Desktop
Getter logic is sound: uses bash ls command with wildcard pattern 'vlc-snap*.png' to check Desktop directory
Metric correctly compares boolean result (file exists) with expected value (exists: true)
Wildcard pattern matches VLC's default snapshot naming convention (vlc-snap-TIMESTAMP.png)
Complete instruction coverage: verifies screenshot was saved to Desktop
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file existence state -> metric compares -> returns score
No postconfig needed since Desktop files persist after task completion
Expected value is semantically correct for this verification task
